speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
question: How does free consciousness become the bound knower?
premises: Sūtra 1: free consciousness causes the world's triple proving.
Sūtra 2: by own will on own ground she opens the world (no borrowed means).
Sūtra 3: manifoldness through fit perceiver-perceived division.
Sūtra 4: contraction of consciousness — yet a knower, world-shrunk.
inference: Cause stated, means refused, manifold explained, veil named: descent promised.
uncertainties: viśvasiddhi gloss revised to triple process (vṛtti + Pradipaka); siddhi≠powers.
